note: Learned layer over foundation's HI-Graph. foundation is the literature prior and is never edited; everything here was produced by measurement inside the loop.

subject: Activity Composition
contradictions.prior_said: Activity Composition has a weak positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: Both applied Activity Composition candidates improved throughput.
evidence: Phase-3 built AC-001 and AC-002.
AC-001 improved sole-owner activity time by 1.4354 h/case (z=-107.85).
AC-002 improved sole-owner activity time by 0.4324 h/case (z=-60.34).
contradictions.note: The measured direction and mechanism support the existing prior.

subject: Activity Elimination
contradictions.prior_said: Activity Elimination has a strong positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: The applied elimination improved throughput and removed work and a gateway/timer.
evidence: Phase-3 built AE-002.
AE-002 reduced sole-owner activity time by 0.1783 h/case (z=-42.8).

subject: Case Assignment
contradictions.prior_said: Case Assignment has a weak positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: CA-001 worsened throughput and waiting despite being applied.
evidence: Phase-3 built CA-001.
CA-001 worsened sole-owner activity time by 0.3232 h/case (z=5.03).
CA-001 also produced waiting increases at A_Incomplete and A_Validating.
contradictions.note: This is a strong candidate-level reversal, but CA-002 also improved by 0.0990 h/case (z=-3.31), so the heuristic-level prior should not yet be changed.

subject: Case-based Work
contradictions.prior_said: Case-based Work has a strong positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: The applied case-based-work redesign improved waiting, duration, and throughput.
evidence: Phase-3 built CBW-002.
CBW-002 improved throughput by 0.3319 h/case (z=-5.69), with waiting z=-6.99 and duration z=-3.48.
contradictions.note: The prior held up for the measurable CBW-002 case.

subject: Contact Reduction
contradictions.prior_said: Contact Reduction has a strong positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: CR-002 made the represented online-only simulation worse in waiting and throughput.
evidence: Phase-3 built CR-002.
CR-002 increased O_Sent waiting by 0.0081 h/case (z=4.91).
The candidate verdict was hurt for waiting, resources, and throughput.
contradictions.note: The separate log estimate of 9.9686 h/case exogenous saving is not comparable with the simulation and must be reported separately, not netted against this measured reversal.

subject: Specialize
contradictions.prior_said: Specialize has a weak positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: SPC-001 was measured as hurt, although the result was shared with the CA-002/CBW-001 activity.
evidence: Phase-3 built SPC-001.
The confirmation counterfactual measured significantly better waiting after removing SPC-001.
The result remained shared at W_Complete application.
contradictions.note: The direction conflicts with the prior, but shared attribution and the absence of a reported z make this insufficient for a heuristic-level revision.

subject: Case Assignment
contradictions.prior_said: Case Assignment has a weak positive time impact and weak positive quality impact.
contradictions.measured_said: CA-001 significantly worsened throughput, waiting, and resources under self-contention rather than improving time.
evidence: CA-001 attributable throughput worsened by 0.5704 h/case with z=8.56.
CA-001 contention increased waiting at A_Incomplete with z=4.19 and A_Validating with z=8.00.
Phase-3 built CA-001 successfully, so this is a measured impact contradiction rather than a structural build failure.
Other Case Assignment candidates were not uniformly harmful: CA-002 improved attributable throughput with z=-3.31 and CA-004 improved O_Returned waiting with z=-10.53.
contradictions.note: Revise the prior to account for capacity and self-contention conditions; the evidence contradicts an unconditional positive time expectation for Case Assignment but does not show that every Case Assignment redesign is harmful.

subject: Contact Reduction
contradictions.prior_said: Contact Reduction has a strong positive time impact and a weak positive cost impact.
contradictions.measured_said: CR-002 worsened the represented online-only process in waiting, resources, and throughput.
evidence: CR-002 O_Sent waiting worsened with z=4.79.
CR-002 attributable throughput worsened by 0.0081 h/case with z=4.91.
The measured verdict was hurt, and Phase-3 built CR-002 successfully.
The separate log estimate of 9.9686 exogenous saving hours/case is not comparable with the simulated columns and was not netted against the measured worsening.
contradictions.note: Revise the represented-process impact of Contact Reduction; retain the exogenous log estimate as a separately reported quantity, not as evidence that the simulated candidate helped.

subject: Case Assignment
contradictions.prior_said: Case Assignment has a weakly positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: CA-001 significantly worsened represented throughput and waiting through self-contention.
evidence: CA-001 attributable throughput worsened, z=5.03
Waiting rose at A_Incomplete, z=4.19, and A_Validating, z=8.00
Phase-3 successfully built CA-001
contradictions.note: The prior's positive time direction is contradicted for this measured application; the evidence supports revising the impact rather than changing compliance or inferring a structural impossibility.

subject: Contact Reduction
contradictions.prior_said: Contact Reduction has a strongly positive time impact.
contradictions.measured_said: CR-002 worsened the represented online-only process in waiting, resources, and throughput.
evidence: CR-002 attributable throughput worsened, z=4.91
O_Sent (online only) waiting rose, z=4.79
Phase-3 successfully built CR-002
contradictions.note: The simulated harm governs the represented process. The separate 9.9686 h/case log estimate is exogenous, not additive to the simulation, and does not cancel this contradiction.
